indicator_name: Yield to maturity of Kazakhstan MinFin Eurobonds (KASE valuation), end of month
description: Доходность к погашению еврооблигаций Минфина РК (оценка KASE), конец месяца
methodology: KASE's YTM; where KASE left it blank (USD bonds 2019-12 to 2020-10) computed from the clean price, 30/360 semi-annual (reproduces KASE's to 0.01 pp). EUR bonds (KZ_10_2811, KZ_14_2609, KZ_27_3409) are EUR yields.
